'''Rhu Caenus Spaceport''' was a spaceport on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] controlled by [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was located in the [[Kaamos Territory]]. [[Geor Vers]] and Lord [[Norn Girard]] were stationed there.
